title: From Hamilton Hobbiton Movie Set Small-Group Tour
includes: Alexander Family Sheep Farm and Shire's Rest
Includes Admission to a fully guided 2.5-hour tour of the Hobbiton Movie Set
Complimentary beverage at the famous Green Dragon Inn
Complimentary pick up and drop off from our Hamilton - Meeting Point
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the magical world of Hobbiton on this small-group tour from Hamilton. Discover the intricacies of the Hobbiton Movie Set, where iconic scenes from 'The Lord of the Rings' and 'The Hobbit' were filmed. With an expert guide, explore charming hobbit holes, picturesque gardens, and significant landmarks like the Green Dragon Inn. Enjoy a complimentary drink at the inn and relax in the stunning Waikato countryside. This day promises an immersive experience for Tolkien fans and movie enthusiasts alike, leaving you with unforgettable memories.

- Duration: 4.5-5 hours including travel from Hamilton
- Small-group tour for a more personalized experience
- Marvel at the picturesque scenery throughout the journey
- Complimentary drink at the Green Dragon Inn and bottled water included
- Wander the 12-acre Movie Set guided by an official Hobbiton expert
